description: This Java class defines an Android activity called CustomConfigurationChangeActivity which extends LoggingActivity. It handles configuration changes manually by overriding the onConfigurationChanged method and is tied to a specific layout. The activity is part of a package related to multi-window playground demonstrations.

classes.name: CustomConfigurationChangeActivity
classes.description: An activity that handles configuration changes explicitly within an Android multi-window environment, extending LoggingActivity to incorporate logging for configuration changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, background color, and description when the activity is created.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Handles configuration changes, such as orientation or size changes, by calling the superclass implementation and relying on LoggingActivity to log the new configuration.
